```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(broom) # function is called tidy()

```


# Results

```{r plotting_block, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "This is my correlation figure."}

plot(cars)

```

```{r analysis_block}
# correlation: correlate variable number 1 with variable number 2

cor_result <- cor.test(x = variable number 1,
                       y = variable number 2)

cor_result_tidy <- tidy(cor_result)

```


Speed and distance were positively correlated, *r* = `r round(cor_result_tidy$estimate, 2)`, *t*(`r cor_result_tidy$parameter`) =  `r round(cor_result_tidy$statistic, 2)`, *p* `r format.pval(cor_result_tidy$p.value, digits = 2, eps =.001)`. See Figure 1.


```{r}
load("bogus_cor_results.RData")
```
